visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are seated at a wooden table in a brightly lit studio. The man on the left wears a black collared shirt and a blue backwards baseball cap, focusing on a large dark green briefcase with a yellow McDonald's 'M' logo. To his right, an older man with glasses in a grey patterned suit listens intently. The background features an urban office setting with a window revealing a city skyline. (2) A close-up pan shows the inside of the opened green briefcase, which contains several clear plastic slots holding colorful collectible cards featuring anime characters. The 'McDonald's' brand name is printed clearly inside. The cards are neatly arranged, showcasing vibrant character art. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the man in the cap gestures toward the case while speaking. The older man observes with an evaluative expression. The man in the cap then closes the case and gives a thumbs up to the camera. (4) The scene shifts to a fast-paced montage with large, bold yellow and white text overlays emphasizing questions about the collection's value. Clips of the men's reactions are spliced together with quick cuts and colorful graphic logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks in a high-pitched, energetic, and casual tone with clear articulation. Upbeat electronic pop BGM at 120 BPM plays with a steady beat. Mechanical clicks and soft thuds are heard as a briefcase is opened. (2) Narration continues enthusiastically over the music. The BGM maintain its rhythmic drive with synthesizers and a clear drum machine. Rising intonations in the voice indicate excitement. (3) The voice poses a request with a confident tone. The music swells slightly in volume during the pause. A sharp digital beep marks the end of the inquiry. (4) A more dramatic, bass-heavy electronic stinger plays for the outro. Audio hard cuts and transition 'whoosh' sounds synchronize with the fast visual edits of the montage, maintaining high information density.
